application_type.evidence: single intraperitoneal injection of 30 mg/kg DMT

setup_restrain.evidence: placing animals in an open arena ... to assess general locomotor activity

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the open arena during the 10-min test

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the open arena during the 10-min test

time_to_assay.evidence: DMT on day 58; behavioral testing days 73-88; 'The OFT was performed on day 4' (~day 76, ~18 days post-DMT; DMT-d28 group ~48 days)

sample_size.evidence: OFT n reported only in Supplementary Fig. 3 (not visible)

outcomes.summary: Neither UCMS nor any treatment (including DMT, DMT+Iso, DMT-d28) altered distance travelled or % time in centre.
outcomes.evidence: we did not observe any statistically significant differences between UCMS saline-treated mice, Non-UCMS controls, or any of the treatment groups following one-way ANOVA analysis of the distance travelled. Similarly, no significant differences were found among groups when measuring time spent in the center

assays.assay_description: Home-cage two-bottle choice (water vs 1% sucrose) in singly housed mice: 24 h two-water habituation, then 48 h test with bottle positions switched at 24 h; sucrose preference (%) calculated. Performed pre-UCMS (baseline), post-UCMS (pre-treatment) and post-treatment (test days 10-13).

application_type.evidence: single intraperitoneal injection of 30 mg/kg DMT

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals were first habituated to drinking water from two bottles for 24 h.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were individually housed ... throughout the test period to allow accurate measurement of individual fluid intake

food_restriction.evidence: During the Sucrose Preference Test (SPT) and Delayed Non-Matching to Place (DNMP) tasks, housing and environmental parameters such as food, water, and lighting were adjusted to align with the respective testing protocols (food access during SPT not specified)

water_restriction.evidence: two bottles (water and 1% sucrose) available throughout the 48 h testing period

time_to_assay.evidence: SPT at baseline, post-UCMS and post-treatment ('conducted between days 10 and 13'); post-treatment SPT ~24 days after DMT (day 58); DMT-d28 group also tested post-UCMS ~3 weeks after its day-28 dose (exact day not stated)

sample_size.evidence: (B, after exclusions): Non-UCMS (n = 8), UCMS (n = 21), UCMS Fluoxetine (n = 8), UCMS DMT-d28 (n = 5) ... (D-E): all groups n = 8

outcomes.summary: UCMS reduced sucrose preference. All DMT regimens (post-UCMS DMT, DMT+Iso, DMT-d28) produced higher post-treatment sucrose preference than UCMS-saline (all p<0.0001), exceeding fluoxetine; DMT-d28 already prevented anhedonia at the post-UCMS assessment with no further pre-to-post change.
outcomes.statistics: one-way ANOVA + Tukey: UCMS vs Non-UCMS p<0.0001; DMT-d28 vs UCMS p<0.0001 (post-UCMS change); post-treatment DMT, DMT+Iso, DMT-d28 vs UCMS saline all p<0.0001; fluoxetine p=0.0179; fluoxetine vs DMT p=0.0029; pre-to-post change DMT p<0.0001, DMT+Iso p=0.0020, DMT-d28 p=0.9905
outcomes.evidence: All DMT-treated groups, including DMT alone, DMT under isoflurane, and DMT-d28, exhibited significantly higher sucrose preference compared to UCMS saline controls (all p < 0.0001)

B1_num_measures.evidence: sucrose preference was calculated as the percentage of sucrose solution consumed relative to total fluid intake (Δ preference is a derived change score of the same measure)

B7_automated_classification.evidence: total volume consumed ... was recorded by an experienced researcher

B8_multivariate.evidence: Univariate ANOVA; Pearson correlation with histology is not multivariate behavioural analysis

assays.assay_description: Mice suspended by the tail (adhesive tape, climb blocker) 45 cm above ground in a 60 x 15 x 70 cm box; immobility time quantified from DeepLabCut pose estimation + custom Python. Single session on test day 7; duration not stated.

application_type.evidence: single intraperitoneal injection of 30 mg/kg DMT

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were suspended by their tails ... tails were gently secured with adhesive tape to a wooden shaft

time_to_assay.evidence: The TST was conducted on day 7 (~day 79, ~21 days after DMT on day 58)

sample_size.evidence: (F): Non-UCMS (n = 6), UCMS Saline (n = 5), UCMS Fluoxetine (n = 6), UCMS DMT (n = 7), UCMS DMT + Iso (n = 6), UCMS DMT-d28 (n = 7)

outcomes.summary: UCMS increased immobility; DMT, DMT+Iso, DMT-d28 and fluoxetine all reduced immobility vs UCMS-saline, with no differences among treatments.
outcomes.statistics: one-way ANOVA + Tukey: UCMS vs Non-UCMS p=0.0043; DMT p<0.0001, DMT+Iso p<0.0001, fluoxetine p=0.0001, DMT-d28 p=0.0002 vs UCMS saline; among treatments all p>0.09
outcomes.evidence: all tested treatments, i.e., DMT (p < 0.0001), DMT+Iso (p < 0.0001), fluoxetine (p = 0.0001), and DMT-d28 (p = 0.0002), effectively reduced immobility compared to UCMS saline controls

B1_num_measures.evidence: Tail suspension test immobility time measured after treatment

B4_ethological.evidence: Immobility is not an ethological measure

E7_social_context.evidence: tests conducted to individually assess ... apathy

D1_continuity.evidence: Tail suspension test was performed only at the post-treatment timepoint

D2_session_duration.evidence: not reported (duration not stated; 'relatively brief task')

D3_recording_days.evidence: The TST was conducted on day 7

assays.assay_name: Delayed Non-Matching to Place Radial Arm Maze (DNMP-RAM)
assays.assay_description: 8-arm radial maze (arms 30 x 8 x 30 cm, 20 cm central platform, removable doors, food wells). Sample phase (≤4 min) then choice phase (≤10 min) with separations S2/S3/S4; 4 trials/day for 15 consecutive days under food restriction (Fruit Loops reward). % correct first choice per separation and learning trajectories; scored manually.

application_type.evidence: single intraperitoneal injection of 30 mg/kg DMT

setup_habituation.evidence: were habituated to the reward five days prior to maze training (reward habituation; apparatus pre-exposure not separately described)

setup_restrain.evidence: the animal was allowed to retrieve the reward within four minutes

food_restriction.evidence: To ensure task motivation, animals had limited access to food during the 15 days of testing

time_to_assay.evidence: behavioral testing (days 73 -88) after DMT on day 58; animals underwent the DNMP-RAM protocol continuously for 15 days

outcomes.summary: UCMS impaired performance in the hard S2 condition; post-UCMS DMT, DMT+Iso and fluoxetine restored S2 performance and learning, whereas DMT-d28 did not. No group differences at S3/S4.
outcomes.statistics: one-way ANOVA + Tukey (S2): UCMS-saline vs Non-UCMS p=0.0165; fluoxetine p=0.0007, DMT p<0.0001, DMT+Iso p=0.0108, DMT-d28 p=0.7273 vs UCMS-saline. RM two-way ANOVA (S2): treatment p<0.0001, training p<0.0001; day-15 Holm-Sidak fluoxetine p=0.0001, DMT p=0.0016, DMT+Iso p=0.0169, Non-UCMS p=0.0049. S3/S4: training p<0.0001, treatment p=0.7677
outcomes.evidence: animals treated with fluoxetine (p = 0.0007), DMT (p < 0.0001), and DMT+Iso (p = 0.0108) displayed significantly enhanced performance compared to the UCMS-saline group

B1_num_measures.evidence: performance reported separately for S2 and for S3/S4, plus learning trajectories (Fig. 3B-D)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Learning trajectories across the 15-day period are between-session, not within-session

B6_cognitive.evidence: assessed cognitive function, specifically reference and working memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: All data were recorded manually during the experiment

E1_environment_type.evidence: The maze consisted of eight arms ... connected to a central round platform

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects; rewards are task stimuli

E6_spatial.evidence: eight arms ... with removable doors, connected to a central round platform

E7_social_context.evidence: the mouse was confined in the start arm

E8_food_water.evidence: small wells at the end for food rewards ... a single reward (a loop of Fruit Loops)

D2_session_duration.evidence: Daily session duration not stated; individual phases ≤4 min and ≤10 min

D5_followup.evidence: Following treatment allocation, animals underwent the DNMP-RAM protocol continuously for 15 days

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same five assays (OFT, EPM, SPT, TST, DNMP-RAM). Coat-state scoring, body weight and histology were excluded as non-behavioural.

time_to_assay: DMT was given on day 58 and behavioural testing ran days 73-88, so every post-treatment assay was >7 days after dosing. Adopted qwen's long_term_over7d; other candidates misread the test-block day numbers as days after dosing.

SPT B1 set to 1 measure (score 0). Δ preference is a derived score of the same variable, and total intake was not reported as a result. TST B1 likewise scored 0 (immobility only). Gemma's score of 1 for value '1' was internally inconsistent.
SPT E3 bedding overridden to 0/low: the paper does not state bedding, and the rubric forbids inferring it from standard housing.

SPT D3 set to 2-7 (three 48 h test periods, about 6 days), overriding the 8-14 given by two candidates, whose evidence did not support that count. D2 >6 h and D6 Yes follow the modal answer (48 h session).
DNMP-RAM D3 set to 15+ (score 3). The paper explicitly states 15 days; candidates who gave 2-7 or 8-14 were inconsistent with their own evidence.
DNMP-RAM B2 set to No: learning curves across days are between-session, which the rubric excludes.
EPM B4 set to Yes. Head dips are manually scored, distinct exploratory acts; deepseek's own evidence argued for Yes despite its score of 0.
OFT/EPM sample sizes set to null because they appear only in Supplementary Fig. 3. Qwen's borrowed TST n's were not used.

Housing: handling set to not_reported. The gentle handling of Non-UCMS mice is a stress-control procedure, not a pre-test habituation protocol. group_housing set to yes (medium): the paper refers to cagemates, and individual housing was specific to the SPT. Light-cycle direction not stated.

SPT food_restriction set to not_reported: the paper says food parameters were 'adjusted' during SPT without specifying how. RAM food_restriction set to before, per the modal answer and the explicit limited food access.
